# Getting help

- **How do I…?** Ask in [Discussions › Q&A](https://github.com/dodo-mojo/dodo/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **Something's broken.** Open a [bug report](https://github.com/dodo-mojo/dodo/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml).
- **I have an idea.** Share it in [Discussions › Ideas](https://github.com/dodo-mojo/dodo/discussions/categories/ideas).
- **I want to help.** Start with a [good first issue](https://github.com/dodo-mojo/dodo/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22), and read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **I found a security problem.** Report it privately, as [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) says.

dodo is made by one person in their spare time, so answers can take a few days.
